objective: Check whether sparse density improvements survive actual SAT solving and produce independent useful relations.
arms: highest-density retained random-pool winner, ties in recorded order
full-curve polynomial, including known two-torsion, followed by cofactor clearing
target_rule: Generate shared nonidentity targets a*P+b*Q with uniform scalars. The solver sees the curve, target point and factor-space encoding only. The known simulation secret constructs Q and verifies final extraction; no target log table or known secret is supplied to SAT or rank elimination.
order: Interleave arms on each target in a seeded randomized order. One solver process at a time.
solver: CaDiCaL via the existing verified S3-chain CNF path. No symmetry pruning assumptions.
full_curve_note: This additional arm deliberately permits the known two-torsion point in the decomposition. Its cofactor image is zero and adds no unknown matrix column. The earlier cofactor control excluding torsion remains distinct.
metrics: first verified discrete-log extraction from a dependency
valid relations per total measured time
timeouts: Censored operational observations, never negative mathematical evidence. Keep all targets and all outcomes.
completion_boundary: A toy extracted logarithm validates the pipeline, not the persistent breakthrough objective. This screen is too small for a scaling or runtime-breakthrough claim.
